build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npx vite build --config vite.singlefile.mjs --base=./ && node scripts/make-singlefile.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self' customprotocol: asset:; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: https: blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob: https:; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; connect-src 'self' https: wss: ws: ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
